reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders inside their fee, and I bill cost-plus, so a new line item means the homeowner has to sign off on it. I wouldn't pay for it out of my own pocket.
objection: I'd be adding a second vendor for something my architect already gives me, and the homeowner would have to agree to pay for it. That is an awkward conversation on a cost-plus job.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see it work on one of my own plans and a homeowner asked for it or said they'd pay for it, I might use it on a spec home where I pay and it helps me sell. I'd need proof it beats what my architect hands me.
